sloka: आश्वासयन्तं भरतं जाबालिर्ब्राह्मणोत्तम: ।उवाच रामं धर्मज्ञं धर्मापेतमिदं वच: ॥ २.१०८.१॥
transliteration: āśvāsayantaṁ bharataṁ jābālirbrāhmaṇottama: ।uvāca rāmaṁ dharmajñaṁ dharmāpetamidaṁ vaca: ॥ 2.108.1॥

translations.english: While Rama, conversant with dharma, was consoling Bharata, Jabali an eminent brahmin addressed him in words contrary to righteousness.
